title: TAP Boot Profile
description: A TAP boot profile: a config-as-code document the bootloader (manage.py boot) applies in fixed phases to stand an instance up from a fresh, migrated database to a populated, usable instance. Profile data files live in the top-level boot/ directory (filename is the profile id). v0 carries a single population section of ordered seed-plugin / fire-collector steps; identity/auth sections and per-app schema composition are deferred (req-boot-sections). Spec: specs/spec-tap-boot-v0.md (req-boot-profile, req-boot-population).

version.description: Profile schema version. 1 for the v0 ordered-steps shape.

description.description: Human label shown by `boot --list` and in review.

auth.description: The auth section (req-tap-auth-boot): external login providers, initial-admin emails, local-password toggle, and admin-lockout break-glass. tap_auth OWNS this section's schema (tap_auth/schemas/auth-boot-section.schema.json) and the bootloader composes it — only its object-shape is asserted here; the boot auth phase validates it strictly against the tap_auth fragment before applying. Omit for a local-password-only standup.

population.description: The population section: ordered steps that bring plugins online and populate them. Omit for a safe, no-outbound auth-only standup (req-boot-profile-4).

on_failure.description: Behavior when a step fails. 'abort' (default): stop, skip the rest, exit non-zero. 'continue': log and proceed; exit code still signals the failure.

steps.description: Ordered list of population steps, applied strictly in array order, sequentially, with no overlap (req-boot-population-1). seed-plugin and fire-collector steps may interleave (req-boot-population-3).

type.description: seed-plugin: bring a plugin online by importing its declared GRIFT bundles via the import_plugin_grift path.

plugin.description: The plugin slug (tap-plugin.toml `slug`), e.g. 'samsite'. Resolved against loaded TAP plugins; an unknown slug aborts before any population step runs (req-boot-population-4).

bundle.description: Optional: import only this named manifest bundle instead of all of the plugin's declared bundles.

enabled.description: false skips the step without removing it (the 'comment it out' affordance).

note.description: Free-text annotation for the human reader (e.g. why a step is ordered where it is).

type.description: fire-collector: fire a collector via run_collection and await its job to terminal.

key.description: The collector's qualified registry key (scope:key) exactly as stored in Collector.collector_registry, e.g. 'plugins.aws_core.collectors.boto3_collector.collector:boto3'. Resolved against the collector registry; an unknown key aborts before any population step runs (req-boot-population-4).

run_mode.description: 'full' (default) runs self-test then collect; 'self_test_only' runs only the readiness probe.

timeout_seconds.description: Seconds to await this collector's job to a terminal state. Omit for the bootloader default (90s); set higher for slow collectors (a full cloud pull). Per-collector default timeouts are a backlog item (req-boot-collector-timeout).

enabled.description: false skips the step without removing it (the 'comment it out' affordance).

note.description: Free-text annotation for the human reader (e.g. why a step is ordered where it is).
